requirements.originalBreakdownItem: Retain citations and attribution for successfully saved content.
requirements.changes: Both full-answer and excerpt saves now freeze only original used source snapshots and complete original version locks. Duplicate/conflicting source identities, missing snapshots and absent versions fail with an accessible guarded message instead of crashing Dictionary construction or silently saving incomplete attribution. Existing answer text remains unchanged. No lookup against newer sources is performed.
requirements.verification: Five new unit tests exercise serialization fidelity, original used-source ordering/version locks, duplicate/conflicting identities, missing snapshots, missing versions and source-free responses. New tests not executed on Mac; changed-file diff check passed.
requirements.remainingIssues: Run unit and actual grounded Ask save/restart journeys on founder Mac. This validates save-boundary integrity, not clinical correctness or APA accuracy independently of the unchanged evidence pipeline.

requirements.originalBreakdownItem: Preserve research retrieval, claim/evidence mapping, medical safety, and citation validation.
requirements.changes: Added an identity preflight before evidence-selection and strict-validator dictionary construction. Duplicate note/extract/claim/source identifiers, blank identifiers and overlapping note/extract namespaces fail closed instead of crashing or selecting ambiguous evidence. Every existing claim-boundary and complete-verbatim-quote check remains intact; no medical safety threshold was lowered.
requirements.verification: Three adversarial XCTest cases added with multiple malformed subcases and positive verbatim/negation/measurement preservation checks. Runtime not executed for new source. Actual bundled JSON identifiers were checked in Python: 5477 unique notes, 295 unique sources, 470 unique source chunks, no blanks and no note/extract ID collisions.
requirements.remainingIssues: Run full grounding suites and controlled offline native FruitfolioAI verification on founder Mac. Structural identities do not independently verify clinical accuracy.

requirements.originalBreakdownItem: Preserve Reduce Motion behavior while eliminating unnecessary lag.
requirements.changes: Ask honors live Reduce Motion changes during retrieval, typing and entry/suggestion reveal. Enabling it completes the exact answer and cancels ticks; disabling it does not restart completed typing.
requirements.verification: Two asynchronous layout-fixture tests added in AskReducedMotionLifecycleTests; not executed. Full app Reduce Motion acceptance is not established by these source changes.
requirements.remainingIssues: Actual live system changes, UI recordings and audio stop on founder Mac/device; other screens require independent verification.

requirements.originalBreakdownItem: Preserve text selection, citation interactions, and accessibility reading order.
requirements.changes: Semantic progressive display and excerpt selection now use global grapheme boundaries with UTF16 span intersections. Combining characters and joined emoji split across styled spans no longer shift later text, truncate clusters or corrupt selected measurements/citations. Original span identities and semantic roles remain intact. Invalid/overflowing selections fail safely.
requirements.verification: Four adversarial Unicode XCTest cases added. Not executed on Mac. Shared eight-role rendering and clinical answer wording are unchanged.
requirements.remainingIssues: Run all existing semantic/selection tests and actual selectable Ask/page-editor UI journeys with screenshots and VoiceOver.
